purpose: Confirm on a live run that codex honors updatedInput, so an L2 rewrite narrows what actually executes.
not_a_collected_pair: Manual single-arm probe. Not a benchmark run pair and not eligible for any quality or efficiency claim.

discriminator.why: The affected tier is observably narrower than the full suite in this workspace, so the test count alone distinguishes honored from ignored.

arms.note: The agent reported the command it asked for, not the one that ran. Only the ledger records what executed.
Same config, same workspace, same prompt. Hooks were silently skipped and no ledger file was created, so the run is indistinguishable from a policy that allowed the full suite.

findings: codex 0.149.0 silently skips hooks in a CODEX_HOME without persisted hook trust; codex doctor reports nothing about hooks.
codex sends PostToolUse tool_response as the raw output string, with no exit code and no status field.
codex PostToolUse tool_input.command echoes the substituted command, independently corroborating the rewrite.
